sentences.text:
By way of present petition, the petitioner has prayed as under:
"17A.

That this Honourable Court may be pleased to issue a writ of Mandamus or a writ in the nature of Mandamus and/or any other appropriate writ or order or direction holding that the utilisation of the subject land of the petitioner by the responsdent no.3 without paying any compensation or any statutory award is in violation of Article 300-A of the Constitution of India and thereupon this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to direct the respondent authorities to initiate appropriate land acquisition proceedings and to pass an award under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and thereupon be pleased to direct them to release the appropriate compensation with statutory benefits as early as possible.

That this Honourable Court may be pleased to issue a writ of Mandamus or a writ in the nature of Mandamus and/or any other appropriate writ or order or direction holding that action of the respondent no.3 is illegal, arbitrary and in violation of Article 21 and 300-A of the Constitution of India and thereupon be pleased to direct the respondent no.3 to award damages or rental compensation with regard to the taking over possession of the subject land.

sentences.text: C. That during the pendency and final disposal of the present petition, this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to pass an interim order directing the respondent no.2 and 3 to calculate the amount of compensation and thereby direct them to pay advance compensation to the petitioners.
D. That this Honourable Court be pleased to pass such other further orders as the nature and circumstances of the case may be demand."
2. Without examining the merits of the case, we hereby dispose of with the following directions.
3. It would be open for the petitioner to file fresh representation with regard to his claim within a period of three weeks from today.
The respondent authority shall consider the representation made by the petitioner in accordance with law as early as possible.
